external_collaboration.evidence_quote: As part of the Erasmus+ programme, EIGT had the pleasure of welcoming a group of students from Porta-Coeli-Schule Himmelpforten in Hamburg, Germany, for an inspiring mobility experience focused on learning, cultural exchange, and European cooperation.
They were warmly welcomed at Lek en Linge school in Culemborg, where they took part in fun, hands-on workshops and got a taste of Dutch culture.

external_collaboration.partner_name: Music Conservatory of the City of Luxembourg
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: It was a great honor and pleasure for the École internationale Gaston Thorn when the Mayor of the City of Luxembourg, Ms Lydie Polfer, and the Minister of Education, Children, and Youth, Mr Claude Meisch, signed the agreement between the École internationale Gaston Thorn and the Music Conservatory of the City of Luxembourg on September 11, 2023.

For this reason, our school has joined a KA210 Erasmus+ project as an official partner, coordinated by France, together with partners from Türkiye and Greece. The project began on 01.10.2025 and will run until 31.03.2027.
